comments.body:
September 30 check: the old guide link reaches the practical guide and its planning section. The Search Console inspections saved at 08:30 UTC show the old route as Page with redirect and the destination indexed with Google's selected canonical matching its URL.

For September 16–22 versus September 23–29, Search Console web results for the two URLs total 12 → 12 clicks and 1,301 → 1,386 impressions. The old route alone is 8 → 1 clicks. Analytics Organic Search landing sessions on resources.pagemantle.com total 18 → 18 for the two paths, with 9 → 9 engaged sessions.

These are small counts. I recommend keeping the move and checking the same group in the next weekly content review, rather than judging it from the old route alone.

Reviewed the destination check and both reporting windows. Keep the current route. Felix, carry this two-page group into our next weekly content review. The counts are too small to call a lasting improvement, but this check does not show lost search entry traffic. This completes the move check.

issues.description:
Clara folded the planning section into [A practical guide to content migration](https://resources.pagemantle.com/guides/a-practical-guide-to-content-migration) on September 23 and updated the reader-facing guide links. Check the old [Planning content migration](https://resources.pagemantle.com/guides/planning-content-migration) route and the destination together before deciding whether the move needs follow-up.

Compare September 16–22 with September 23–29, two complete seven-day windows. Search Console scope is web search across both exact URLs, all countries and devices, without a query filter. Analytics scope is Organic Search landing sessions on resources.pagemantle.com for the same two paths.

Keep the destination check, dated inspections and acquisition review here. Felix owns the measurement check. Rachel reviews the recommendation.
issues.title: Check search entry traffic after the content-migration guide move
